facts.value: Dance has been a constant part of my life from a very young age and I always knew I wanted to study it and pursue it as a profession. When I researched courses, I was drawn to the BA in Contemporary Dance because of its diverse mix of subjects and also the fact that the Irish World Academy of Music and Dance looked like an amazing place to study.
